en.name: Relish
en.summary: Relish is chopped pickled vegetables in a sweet-sour brine, and the vinegar and sugar make it very stable. Unopened it keeps about 30 months from purchase in the cupboard, and about 9 months refrigerated. Freezing is not recommended.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 30 months from purchase in a cool, dry, dark cupboard — a long life that comes straight from the vinegar and sugar. Store it upright, away from the hob and out of sunlight, which bleaches the colour. Do not keep a jar that has lost its vacuum, is leaking, or fizzes on opening. Once the jar has been opened, it belongs in the fridge rather than back on the shelf.
en.fridge: Refrigerated, relish runs about 9 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Keep the solids under the liquid so nothing dries at the surface, use a clean spoon each time, and wipe the rim before closing — a sticky thread is what makes a lid seat badly and lets air in. Never return relish from a plate or a hot dog to the jar, and do not serve straight from the storage jar at a barbecue; spoon what you need into a bowl.
en.freezer: Freezing relish is not recommended and no freezer timeline is given for it. The chopped vegetables are mostly water and lose their crunch entirely, leaving a watery, separated mush when thawed — and the fridge already gives you months. If you have made a large home batch, canning it to a tested recipe is the route to long storage, not the freezer.
spoilage: Mould on the surface, around the rim or under the lid
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A domed lid, or fizzing and spurting when the jar is opened
tips: Spoon relish into a bowl for the table; never serve from the storage jar.
Use a clean spoon and wipe the rim before closing.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Keep the jar out of sunlight, which dulls the colour quickly.

faq.q: How long does relish last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 9 months from purchase at 4 °C or below, with the solids kept under the liquid.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of relish keep?
faq.a: About 30 months from purchase in a cool dry cupboard.
Freezing is not recommended and no timeline is given. The vegetables lose their crunch and thaw watery.

faq.q: Does relish need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Put it in the fridge once the jar is opened rather than returning it to the cupboard.

zh.name: 甜酸醃菜醬
zh.summary: Relish 是切碎的醃漬蔬菜泡在甜酸醃汁裡，靠醋和糖讓它非常穩定。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 30 個月；冷藏大約 9 個月。不建議冷凍。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 30 個月——這麼長的壽命完全來自醋和糖。請直立擺放、遠離爐火、避免日曬，陽光會讓顏色褪掉。已經沒有真空感、會滲漏，或開罐時冒氣的罐子就不要留。開封之後，它該進冰箱，而不是放回架上。
zh.fridge: 冷藏在 4 °C 以下，從購買日起算大約 9 個月。請讓固形物保持在液面以下，避免表面乾掉；每次用乾淨的湯匙，蓋回去前擦瓶口——黏答答的螺紋會讓蓋子蓋不平、空氣跑進去。盤子上或熱狗上用剩的絕對不要倒回罐子；烤肉時也不要直接拿保存罐上桌，請舀到碗裡。
zh.freezer: Relish 不建議冷凍，也沒有提供冷凍期限。切碎的蔬菜幾乎都是水，冷凍後會完全失去脆度，解凍只剩出水分離的糊——而冷藏本來就能放好幾個月。自己做了一大批的話，依經驗證的配方裝罐殺菌才是長期保存的方法，不是冷凍。
spoilage: 醬面、瓶口或蓋子內側長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣噴出
tips: 上桌時舀到碗裡，不要直接用保存罐。
用乾淨的湯匙，蓋回去前擦瓶口。
避免日曬，陽光很快會讓顏色變暗。

faq.q: Relish 放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏在 4 °C 以下，從購買日起算大約 9 個月，並讓固形物保持在液面以下。

faq.q: 未開封的 relish 可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 30 個月。
不建議，也沒有提供期限。蔬菜會失去脆度，解凍後出水。
要。開封後請放冰箱，不要放回櫥櫃。
